quest.title: A Returning Customer
quest.description: Siegfria can't stop thinking about the delectable Jade Parcels. Oh how she wants to taste it again...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x1800, Crystal Chunk x1, Mora x1800, White Iron Chunk x1, Mora x1800

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll see it done.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Great! Thank you so much. I'll be waiting over here.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Hehe... I'll finally be able to eat Jade Parcels again...

talks.objective: Give the Jade Parcels to Siegfria

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like anything else?

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Ugh, well... I'd also like to eat other things. But if I tried to eat everything, then I wouldn't be able to eat anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: So I'd like to get a firm grasp on how Jade Parcels taste first.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: ...Ah, they're all gone.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: The mouthfeel of those vegetables... the perfectly paired flavors of the ham and the lotus... and that soup...

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: This is it — this is the flavor that I tasted the last time!

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Thanks for coming over just to make me this dish. I need to go back and make some notes.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Next we meet, I will definitely be able to make a batch of perfect Jade Parcels.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: When that time comes, do swing by to have a taste.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: The freshness of the ham, the mouthfeel of the vegetables, and this faint spiciness...

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Hmm, this is not bad. It's a really good serving of Jade Parcels!

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Ugh... These vegetables are so dry, and it feels like there are some ingredients that weren't cooked all the way through...

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: It's a far cry from what I had before... is this some new method of cooking that you came up with?

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: There's just something off about it... but I can still use it for reference.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: How am I already hungry again...

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you! Wonderful. Do you still remember me?

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: From the cook-off, with Xiangling? That was me, Siegfria!

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Hehe, do you remember now? Anyway, you've come at a great time. Could I... ask you to help me with something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Do you still recall the Jade Parcels that you made the previous time?

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: They were so delicious, I can still taste them, even now.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: So I wanted to give it a try and make some myself, but... it always feels like there's something missing...

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: I feel like if I get to try it a few more times, I can recreate that flavor too!

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: So, could I ask you to make some Jade Parcels for me to try?

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: This is great! I'll finally get to taste the Jade Parcels you make again.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: I do know the recipe, and I have been able to figure out how to make it, but it doesn't quite match the flavor it had when you made it.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only you could make those Jade Parcels for me a few more times. There are still many intricacies to them that I have yet to work out.

dialogues.speaker: Siegfria
dialogues.text: Are the Jade Parcels ready yet?
